reviews.reason: Re-read the complete VisKoP abstract and literal output. Add the omitted KoPL engine alias outside URLs; KoPL program language and UI operations remain outside model/task/dataset scope. KBQA is a task, KB is not a benchmark.

Active learning and hybrid labeling are explicit methodological strategies; annotation and data labeling are named activities. The hands-on tutorial is usable training text only, not a new original-research publication or an independent dataset. Generic final/synthetic dataset remains unlabeled.

Keep source LLama-3 spelling and both named components RecurrentGenerator/RecurrentDetector. Text understanding and generation is the coordinated task span; recurrent generation itself is a failure behavior, not a benchmark. No operational exploit material is collected.

Keep the qualitative interview document unresolved. ML community/practitioners refer to people or field, not scientific model names; do not assert complete all-O labels or fabricate 17 interviews as a DATASET name.

FiLM and deep learning models are METHOD; visual question answering and quantifier interpretation are TASK. Approximate number system is an observed emergent phenomenon, Weber's law a theoretical law, and designed scenes are unnamed data.

Preserve case-sensitive task variants and longest same-class 3D segmentation spans. VFMs, hashing and similarity filtering are methods; masks/scene are objects. ScanNet/SceneNN are explicitly benchmarks. Generic priors and state-of-the-art are not additional entities.

MTL is the acronym of the transformer-based multi-task method. Information-type classification and priority estimation are explicit tasks, emergency messages are input objects. TREC IS is described as a track, so its benchmark dataset identity is not assumed.

Add the contiguous diffusion transformer family at the backbone mention, instead of two adjacent shorter family spans there. Keep separated diffusion and transformer in the integrates clause. MS-CDT is a method; tracer separation is the task. Brain/chest PET collections are unnamed, not fabricated benchmark IDs.

Explicit material-design objectives are tasks while metamaterial units are physical objects. Keep the proposed full uncertainty-aware design method and optimization comparator families; aleatoric/epistemic uncertainties are properties. Do not create DATASET from the design problems.

Retain quarantine: standalone debiasing as TASK cannot be declared globally without creating a cross-type overlap inside the METHOD name. The partial method list is not a complete NER training sample; no missed task tokens are used as O labels.

OSQP/RLQP and reinforcement learning are methods; optimization/control/tuning are explicit tasks. QPLIB, Netlib LP and Maros-Meszaros name evaluation problem collections and are benchmark DATASET entities. Solver speed-up is a result, not a new relation asserted here.

SNN denotes Spectral Neural Networks, not spiking neural networks in this document. Linear/vanilla network families and gradient descent are methods; sensing/learning are matrix tasks, singular vectors and entries are objects. No source punctuation repair is performed.

CriticGPT and reward/policy learning are methodological mentions; decision-making, trajectory understanding and robot manipulation are tasks. Meta-World is the named evaluation task suite, while preference accuracy is a metric and preference feedback an output. No critic or reward coreference relation is filled automatically.

NN/ML surface forms are method families. Preserve the long explicit channel-dimension prediction task rather than classifying ceramic/channels as tasks. Laser parameters are input features, not dataset names; scanner setup is not operational code or newly collected engineering instructions.

Neural-Q-Whittle and its Q-learning/stochastic approximation families are methods; RMAB is a problem acronym. Q-function/Whittle-index values are objects, their finding/approximation are tasks. Markov chain and Lyapunov drift denote mathematical modeling/analysis techniques, not DATASET names.

SmoothGuard and explicit noise-injection/aggregation/clustering approaches are methods; adversarial-image generation and filtering are task mentions only. Preserve the full In-the-Wild benchmark name. Noise values/distribution and candidate outputs are not model entities.

AWD full name and acronym are methods along with neural/wavelet families. Cosmological parameter inference and molecular-partner prediction are explicit tasks; interpretability is a property and no domain collection is named. Do not infer a dataset from the package link.

MeshODENet, GNNs and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations are methods. Simulation/long-term prediction/system modeling are tasks; mesh and elastic bodies are physical representations, not datasets. Explicit unnamed solvers do not receive invented names.

Keep literal lowercase gpt-4o and SFT/fine-tuning method mentions. Broad application domains and moral alignment are not specific TASK names under this scope. Correct-data percentages are experimental settings, not dataset identities.

Add the explicit hyphenated system-family mention missed by the standalone GNN literal rule. Preserve detection and reverse-engineering task phrases without treating circuits/Trojans as tasks. This survey is training text, not new graph research evidence; unnamed benchmarks remain untagged.

TimeWarp is a data-generation method, not the name of its unnamed preference dataset. Preserve explicit video-captioning and temporal-understanding tasks; language-based reasoning is methodological style here. Seven unnamed benchmarks and generic descriptive tasks do not become proper-name entities.
